newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Air crashes in CIS planes kill 292 people in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Air crashes in CIS planes kill 292 people in 1996.

text.p: A total of 292 people were killed in air crashes last year involving aircraft from the 12 former Soviet republics in the Commonwealth Independent States, up from 246 in 1995, the CIS Interstate Aviation Committee (IAC) said on Wednesday.

It said in a statement that 20 fatal crashes and 57 other incident involving CIS planes and helicopters were registered last year. There were 74 incidents the year before, but only 18 of them were fatal.
